scope: Historical primary preclinical drug evidence: the studies below did not test G359E and do not establish a clinical response predictor. Subsequent exact-variant reporter evidence is summarized separately in functional_assessment.json.

zhang_2010.verified_by: Full primary HTML read from PMC with native HTTPS; figures/results/discussion inspected.
zhang_2010.model: MC38 and SW620 lacked detectable SMAD4; comparison with stable SMAD4 addback. MC38 KRAS codons12/13/61 wild type; SW620 activated KRAS.
zhang_2010.noncanonical: TGF-beta increased ERK phosphorylation. Tested p38MAPK, TAK1, JNK and AKT were unaffected (data not shown). RhoA/PP2A also unchanged. ERK contribution inferred, not established by a decisive ERK-rescue experiment.
zhang_2010.drug_results: LY2109761 reduced MC38 proliferation, migration/invasion, anchorage-independent growth, subcutaneous tumour growth and experimental liver metastasis; mouse survival increased.
zhang_2010.addback: SMAD4 restored TGF-beta growth inhibition in MC38 and reduced invasion/metastasis in both lines. SW620 addback did NOT restore antiproliferative TGF-beta response; activated RAS was the proposed explanation.
zhang_2010.limits: Different drug from vactosertib; complete protein absence/addback, not G359E. Splenic injection bypasses early metastatic steps. No genotype-by-treatment predictive interaction or patient response evidence.

ly2109761_target_scope.description: Original pancreatic study describes LY2109761 as a dual TGF-beta receptor type I/type II inhibitor; not identical target scope/pharmacology to vactosertib.

tauriello_2018_correction.verified_by: Indexed full-text primary author manuscript and author university repository published-PDF extraction; direct legacy PDF URL now404.
tauriello_2018_correction.main_model: LAKTP: Apc/Kras/Tgfbr2/Trp53 alterations, intestinal lineage tracing.
tauriello_2018_correction.additional_model: LAKP plus CRISPR Smad4 loss-of-function = LAKPS (LAKP+S), explicitly shown in Figure2i-k and ExtendedData8d. Two guides verified by SMAD4 western blot; guide1 used in Figure2k.
tauriello_2018_correction.results: LAKPS resisted TGF-beta cytostasis and formed more/larger liver metastases than parental LAKP. Galunisertib abrogated LAKPS metastatic capacity and did not enhance metastasis growth from Tgfbr2-wild-type parental LAKP.
tauriello_2018_correction.correction: Earlier blanket characterization of this study as not including a SMAD4-mutant model was incomplete. Main LAKTP model is Tgfbr2-deficient, but the additional LAKPS experiment is directly relevant to tumour-cell SMAD4 loss.
tauriello_2018_correction.limits: Galunisertib, not vactosertib. Experimental knockout, not G359E. Does not establish preferential human benefit from SMAD4 loss.

direct_vactosertib_distinction.b16_description: EW-7197 suppressed B16 melanoma and enhanced cytotoxic T-cell activity; ALK5 inhibition caused SMAD4 ubiquitination/degradation in CD8 T cells, relieving Eomes repression. This supports immune-compartment action; not a tumour-SMAD4-loss response biomarker.
direct_vactosertib_distinction.crc_5fu_description: Direct vactosertib/5-FU CRC preclinical study exists; xenograft vactosertib administration was intratumoral, and it is not an SMAD4-isogenic predictive comparison.
direct_vactosertib_distinction.hyl001_caution: 2026 clinical paper reference14 is primarily HYL001 development. Do not relabel its HYL001/anti-PD1 in-vivo efficacy as vactosertib efficacy. Vactosertib appears as comparator in biochemical/cellular and toxicity work.

clinical_inference: If G359E causes impairment, it could remove tumour-suppressive canonical TGF-beta signalling while receptor-driven noncanonical and stromal/immune signalling persist. This makes TGF-beta blockade biologically coherent, but neither proves current SMAD4 loss nor predicts vactosertib benefit.
functional_evidence_update: 17 November2026: investigators report impaired G359E reporter signalling; this does not change the drug/model distinctions below.
